news.headline: Rare Aztec manuscript returns to Mexico on loan after nearly two centuries in France
news.summary: A prized 16th-century manuscript chronicling the rise and fall of the Aztec Empire has gone on display in Mexico City, nearly two centuries after it was taken to France, as Mexico continues to press Paris for its permanent return.
